statement: AMD disclosed or reiterated large deployment partnerships at Advancing AI 2026: Anthropic at 2GW of Helios, OpenAI at 6GW with pre-production Helios by end of 2026, Meta co-developing rack-scale OCP standards, plus AT&T and Cisco.
why: A stack of named multi-gigawatt customers is the strongest available evidence that buyers are committing real volume to a non-incumbent accelerator vendor.

impact.mechanism: Named gigawatt-scale design wins convert into forward accelerator orders and validate second-source supply for frontier training and inference.

evidence.source: ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
evidence.excerpt: OpenAI: previously announced 6GW AMD hardware deployment; pre-production Helios deployment planned for end of 2026.

evidence.source: ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
evidence.excerpt: Anthropic: committing to 2GW of Helios hardware (see companion AMD/Anthropic press release dated 2026-07-22)

confidence.basis: Secondary keynote live-blog; the Anthropic element is separately backed by an AMD press release but the rest is single-outlet reporting of vendor statements.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: AMD Investor Relations (ir.amd.com), ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
